cards: **V3 · Motif calls emitted for Capsida NR001–NR005 and Lir Starfish binding-assay readouts.** seed pick · compute tested: yes · plan expects: not the lever · PASS **Question.** Can computed capsid–receptor binding calls for ALPL, AAVR and LRP6 reproduce published bind/no-bind readouts with interfaces at the threefold axis? **What is known.** Shay and colleagues in 2024 ran five AlphaFold-Multimer models per peptide and used cryo-ET to map where LRP6 and IL3 bind engineered capsids, with SPR binding labels [s_shay_af]. Whether hundreds of pose and seed runs improve bind/no-bind agreement with threefold-axis geometry across a full capsid-by-receptor grid remains untested [s_shay_af]. **Hypothesis.** Pairs that bind in plate- and bead-based assays share threefold-axis or insert-loop engagement geometry, so pose enumeration recovers published bind/no-bind labels [s_aavr_struct]. **If compute is the lever.** Balanced accuracy 0.80 at 432 runs versus 0.55 at 54, with five of six known binders within 5 Å of published sites. **If not.** Accuracy moves under 0.05 between 54 and 432 runs and at most three of six binders reach published sites; extra runs resample the wrong basin. **Test.** Thirty-six capsid–receptor pairs run docking, three AlphaFold-Multimer seeds, two 5-ns MD relaxations; calls and threefold-site geometry scored on published labels; parallel wall-clock versus serial one-GPU and independent-copy baselines. *Compute axis.* Independent capsid–receptor model runs (docking, AlphaFold-Multimer, MD relaxation) the answer needs: 54–432 model runs, 3 levels. Closest prior: 10 [s_shay_af], beyond it. *Restructuring.* none. **Check first.** Redocking AAVR-PKD2 onto AAV2 must place it beside the threefold spike matching PDB 6IHB contacts; serial and parallel pilots must match calls. gate.else: take the docking-plus-MD fallback line with one AlphaFold-Multimer seed per pair, or move the grid to 12 pairs

phase.what: Run the 216-run main grid on 8x A100; emit the plate-layout call table and bead-panel CSV with bind/no-bind, score, interface residues, distance to nearest threefold axis and site class.
phase.stop_rule: 24-hour timer or all 216 runs complete; hard stop at spend_cap_usd

anchor.what: Redocking AAVR-PKD2 onto AAV2 must place it beside the threefold spike matching PDB 6IHB contacts; serial and parallel pilots must match calls.
anchor.published_value: PKD2 bound to the AAV2 spike region adjacent to the icosahedral three-fold axis (PDB 6IHB)
anchor.tolerance: >=50% contact overlap at the published 4.5 Å cutoff or interface backbone RMSD <=5 Å; serial versus parallel top-pose RMSD <=2 Å with identical bind/no-bind calls
anchor.independent_code: LightDock and pyDock both run the anchor pair; a consensus pose is required before phase p2_main

predictions.if_lever: Balanced accuracy 0.80 at 432 runs versus 0.55 at 54, with five of six known binders within 5 Å of published sites.
predictions.if_not: Accuracy moves under 0.05 between 54 and 432 runs and at most three of six binders reach published sites; extra runs resample the wrong basin.
predictions.noise_rule: Three independent seed sets per run level, mean and SD reported; a gap counts only if it exceeds 2x the SD across seed sets and a paired permutation test over the 13 labels gives p < 0.05.
